property.value:
build: pin tested WebJar transitive versions (#1583)
Preserve the verified 52-WebJar application inventory while pinning every active transitive range. The metadata-free Maven reproduction, real-classpath regression, normal packaging, byte-level inventory comparison and independent review passed. All 42 current-head checks passed with five expected conditional skips; all applicable workflows succeeded on attempt one.
Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
